experiment: MNEME Phase 3.7 Semantic Vector Qualification Hammer Test
plain_english: No tested bespoke exact-Q2 Gemma control vector made its intended conceptual structure recognizably accessible in unrelated prompts. The full ecological dose sweep stayed semantically indistinguishable from untreated generic advice; a matched random vector became destructive at high gain.

host.runtime: llama.cpp local CUDA, isolated disposable server
host.layer_contract: ignore l_out capture zero; apply explicit directions 1 through 41

baseline_qualification.finding: The replacement prompts elicited generic stages, zoning, or checklists but not the complete diagnostic structures: pioneer conditions enabling later organization; independent coherent lines with planned interaction and resolution; or distinct detection, containment, and evidence-based escalation layers.

rejected_prevector_attempts.reason: Initial software/agent prompt set already elicited target-adjacent framing; no vectors constructed.
Fixed-port stale-server routing risk; partial untreated baseline only; no vectors constructed.

screen.pruning: All mean/median × four-layer-range ecological, counterpoint, and defense candidates were inert at the predeclared moderate gain. No candidate passed to a full multi-target validation. Ecological succession received the one full dose/control sweep because it was first in the frozen priority order.

random_norm_layer_matched.high_gain_observation: At gain 1.5, three calls exhausted the token allowance in reasoning with no visible final answer; the remaining final answer was 111 bytes of vacuous text.

ecological_full_controls.thermal_pruning: Further high-gain sign-reversal launches were stopped after the high-gain random control sustained 86 C GPU temperature. Every completed call and partial manifest was persisted; no result was discarded.

representative_coordinate.unrelated_prompt: A community radio station has lost listeners after a long period of irregular programming. It has a small budget, several aging shows, and volunteers with different interests. What should its programming committee do next?
representative_coordinate.baseline: recommended schedule consistency, identity, and engagement
representative_coordinate.median_candidate_gain_1_5: recommended consistency, predictability, and community connection; no pioneer, enabling-condition, path-dependent succession, or maturation structure in reasoning or final answer
representative_coordinate.random_gain_1_5: ran to length in reasoning and returned no visible final answer
representative_coordinate.interpretation: The semantic candidate did not make the desired source framing accessible; the random vector established that stronger perturbation can damage generation without creating that framing.

observed: The corrected exact-Q2 vector path reliably constructed and applied all 41 explicit directions.
None of 24 target/method/layer screen coordinates showed the intended target-specific cross-domain structure.
The ecological median vector did not show target-specific behavior at any tested positive gain or at low-gain sign reversal.
A norm/layer-matched random vector was increasingly harmful at high gain.
inferred: The present balanced mean/median contrast construction does not yield trustworthy semantic vector targets for MNEME neural compilation.
unresolved: Whether a materially different representation, construction objective, full-precision host, or larger published-method implementation can yield semantic transfer.

recommendation: Do not begin another open-ended vector hunt or rent an A100 to scale the same unqualified target construction. Park this control-vector substrate for MNEME unless the owner authorizes a specifically different upstream semantic-vector qualification method.
